ceilings: at most 40 transmitted frames, 60 s route time; no extension, no retry

classification_rules.feedback_over_170ms: FAIL with exact per-stage excess (UE raw-clock and edge wall-clock stages reported separately); deadline and reward unchanged
classification_rules.superseded_after_verified_warmup: REWARD_FRAME_PROTECTION_REQUIRED - stop; no scheduler change without review

pass_requires: all UE and edge warm-up paths completed before admission
one rewarded decision plus its required hold
rewarded frame reaches edge inference and evaluator submission
all three GT components identity-matched and readable (host == container == preserved)
object-GT queue wait and compute reported separately (HIGH class)
exact Q_perc returned through the UE feedback path
zero unresolved tickets, unknown orphans, conflicts or infrastructure faults
